content_sections.heading: SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies are available - 2 for Senior Resident (Hospital Services) - Maternal and Reproductive Health (MRH) and 4 for Senior Resident (Hospital Services) - Radiodiagnosis.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SGPGIMS?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident (Hospital Services) posts at SGPGIMS is scheduled for 25 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Senior Resident (Hospital Services) positions at SGPGIMS. These are distributed across different specializations as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SGPGIMS recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for the General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to clear both stages to be considered for the positions.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the SGPGIMS office in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Specific details about the exact venue and reporting time will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The Senior Resident (Hospital Services) posts are on a Contract basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of SGPGIMS?
faq.answer: The official website of Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences is https://sgpgims.org.in. All official updates and notifications are usually posted here.

faq.question: Q10. Are there specific qualifications required for each post?
faq.answer: The provided data does not detail specific qualifications for each post. Candidates are strongly encouraged to consult the official notification for precise educational and professional qualification requirements for each Senior Resident specialization.
